description: Look up one ecommerce store by domain. The reply has company data, estimated revenue, marketing budget, traffic, Google and Meta ad spend, ad counts, a Conversion Rate Score, buying signals, the store phone number, and social and ad-library links. Decision-maker contact fields are not in the fields list. With OAuth access, the decisionMakers object shows the contacts that you revealed. When other active stores use the same base domain, the reply has sharedMetrics. Those stores show the same traffic and ad numbers, because the data belongs to the base domain. Limits: anonymous access, 20 lookups per hour per IP. OAuth access, 20 lookups per minute, and the call writes a lookup history row.

domain.description: The store domain, for example example.com. A full URL also works.

name: lookupStore
title: Look up a store
